project_type: Node.js/Express backend + Next.js 16 frontend with TypeScript, MongoDB database
build_system: npm scripts - backend uses node --watch for dev, frontend uses next dev/build
test_framework: node --test for backend, no frontend tests configured
build_command: npm run build (frontend), npm run check (backend validation)
verification_instructions: Run backend tests with 'npm run test' in backend directory, start both services and test admin UI manually
environment_constraints: Requires MongoDB connection, uses httpOnly cookies for auth, Next.js App Router with strict TypeScript
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: zod validation, asyncHandler wrapper, requireRoles middleware, audit logging for admin actions
key_patterns: Models use mongoose schemas with timestamps and optimistic concurrency. API routes use express.Router with auth/validation middleware. Admin pages use useApiResource hook with demo fallbacks. All admin routes require staff roles.
directory_structure: backend: src/routes/ (API routes), models/ (Mongoose schemas), src/middleware/ (auth, validation). frontend: app/admin/ (admin pages), lib/ (utilities), components/ (reusable UI)
